messages.text: Give me a list of the episode titles and their literal English translations

Based on the provided images, here is a list of the episode titles from the "SAT: Scalar-Angular Theory" podcast, along with their literal English translations. Please note that while the titles are found in the sources, the English translations provided below are not from the sources and were translated to assist you; you may wish to verify them independently.
From Source

一种几何直观的万物理论 (Chinese)
Translation: A Geometrically Intuitive Theory of Everything

Translation: The Geometrically Intuitive Theory of Everything
1
.
የስካላር-አንጉላር-ቶርሽን (SAT) ቲዎሪ መሰረታዊ ምስሎች አዲስ የጊዜና የቦታ ትርጓሜ (አማርኛ) (Amharic)
Translation: Scalar-Angular-Torsion (SAT) Theory's basic concepts: A new interpretation of time and space (Amharic)

Translation: The SAT Theory: Filaments - Past and Present - Theory of Everything

A Skalár-Szög-Torziós (SAT): Elmélet A Valóság Újraértelmezése (Hungarian)
Translation: The Scalar-Angular-Torsion (SAT): Theory - The Reinterpretation of Reality
2

From Source

A Geometrically Intuitive Theory of Everything (English)

SAT-Teoria: Massa Ajan Virtauksen Kulmana Aikakenttä (Finnish)
Translation: SAT-Theory: Mass as the Angle of Time Flow in the Time-field

Translation: Filaments, Time-surfaces, Mass as Angle - The radical SAT-theory
